title: opendap.craft-rules/v1: the PCB craft standard's rules as data (tools/craft/rules.toml)
description: Every CRAFT rule of kicad-lib's docs/specs/pcb-craft-standard.md, in the standard's order. The standard's rule tables are rendered from it (odapkit craft rules render) and the craft checks read their levels and limits from it.

spec.description: URL of the craft standard the rules belong to.

cell.description: One table cell of the standard, as Markdown: one line, no '|'. An em dash when the standard gives none.

section.description: The standard's section whose table lists the rule, for example "3" or "9.4".

level.description: The lowest level at which the rule is mandatory; one of levels.

source.description: The sources, cited exactly as the standard cites them (reference keys of its Sources section, requirement IDs, RFCs).

limits.description: Values a check or a generator reads, each one stated in the rule's row (rule or value). Numbers in millimetres where the key ends in _mm.
